about_the_game:
Welcome to ReDrop, a pixel-art precision platformer where dying creates platforms and pain is part of the journey. In the full game, you’ll explore an open world, unlock multiple endings, and suffer gloriously with health regen, save files, and just enough mercy to keep going.

This demo? None of that.

No saves. No health regen. 1/5th the health. Limited map paths. No forgiveness.

Think of it as a stress test, for both the game and your sanity. If you want to suffer the correct way, play the full game!

ReDrop is a pixel-art precision platformer where dying isn’t failure, it’s progress. Each death leaves a platform behind to help you overcome obstacles.

Sounds easy? Just keep dying and you’ll reach the end.

Except… your own platforms can also trap you. Easy jumps turn impossible. You might smack your head on a platform you just created. One unlucky death can block your path.

So, ready to drop in?


It all starts inside a strange capsule in a lab, where a mysterious purple slime begins to mutate… and then BOOM!

Suddenly, you’re lost in an unknown world. Explore! Climb through weird environments, dodge deadly traps and creatures, and find your way out!

What’s the fate of the little purple slime? Try to unlock all endings, even the secret one, or rage quit trying. It’s harder than it looks, and you’ll die... a lot. Seriously, a LOT.

Will you give in to rage before beating them all?

If you really want to suffer, we encourage you to speedrun the game!

You can measure the time you’ve wasted thanks to the in-game timers: one measures the time for the whole gameplay, one resets after every death.

So don’t worry! Even if you keep dying for a whole day, you’ll be able to see for how long you weren’t able to complete the game!
